positions.title: Wire Harness Assembler I
positions.summary: Hands-on production role building wire harnesses and cable assemblies at our Kansas City facility — no prior experience required, we'll train the right person.
positions.description:
Quality Cable Systems (QCS) builds wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and box builds for OEM customers who depend on quality and reliability. Our work goes directly into equipment in the field, so getting it right matters. We're under new leadership and investing heavily in technology, people, and processes. We want QCS to be a destination workplace where people are respected, challenged, and given opportunities to grow.

We're currently looking for Wire Harness Assemblers to join our growing team. Whether you have previous manufacturing experience or are looking to build a long-term career in production, we're looking for people who are dependable, motivated, and take pride in doing quality work.

This role is based on-site at our Kansas City, MO facility. You will report to Production Leadership and work closely with Team Leads and fellow assemblers on the production floor.

What you'll do: build wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and related products using work instructions, drawings, hand tools, and production equipment. You'll learn to read and follow build documentation, identify quality issues, and complete assemblies accurately and efficiently. You'll also help maintain a clean, organized, and safe work environment while supporting packaging, labeling, and other production-related activities as needed.

Starting pay typically ranges from $18–$24 per hour depending on experience, with opportunities for advancement as skills develop. We also offer health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k) with company match; paid time off and holidays; and training and advancement opportunities.

What we're looking for: dependable with strong attendance and work ethic; comfortable working with your hands and performing repetitive tasks; detail-oriented and committed to producing quality work; able to follow written and verbal instructions; willing to learn new skills and processes; comfortable in a fast-paced manufacturing environment; able to work well as part of a team. Previous manufacturing, assembly, warehouse, or skilled trades experience is a plus, but not required — we are willing to train the right person.

Physical requirements: ability to stand for extended periods during shifts; frequent use of hands for repetitive assembly tasks; ability to lift and move materials up to 25 pounds occasionally; ability to identify colors, small components, and detailed assembly work.

To apply, reach out to careers@qualitycablesystems.com.

positions.title: Manufacturing Engineer
positions.summary: On-site engineering role improving production processes, establishing labor standards, and building the operational foundation for QCS's next phase of growth.
positions.description:
Quality Cable Systems (QCS) builds wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and box builds for OEM customers who depend on quality, reliability, and responsiveness. We're under new leadership and investing in technology, people, and processes to build the next generation of QCS.

We're currently looking for a Manufacturing Engineer to help us improve how work gets done across our operation. This role sits at the intersection of production, quality, engineering, and continuous improvement. If you enjoy solving problems, working with people, and making measurable improvements on the shop floor, we'd love to talk with you.

This role is based on-site at our Kansas City, MO facility with daily presence on the production floor. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with production, quality, procurement, and engineering. This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration.

What you'll do: improve the way work flows through our manufacturing operation by analyzing processes, identifying improvement opportunities, and implementing practical solutions that increase safety, quality, throughput, and efficiency. You'll spend time on the production floor conducting time studies, identifying bottlenecks, and working with team leads and operators to establish labor standards and improve workflows. You'll create and maintain work instructions, process documentation, visual standards, and training materials. You'll collect, analyze, and report on production metrics such as labor efficiency, throughput, quality, on-time delivery, and equipment utilization. You'll apply statistical analysis tools (SPC, process capability studies, variation analysis) to identify root causes and reduce defects. You'll also lead cost-benefit analysis and ROI justification for capital investments, and help build and execute QCS's annual capital spend plan.

We offer competitive compensation based on experience and are happy to discuss details during the interview process.

What we're looking for: experienced in manufacturing, production, industrial engineering, or continuous improvement; comfortable spending significant time on the production floor; experienced conducting time studies, process analysis, or productivity initiatives; detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable collecting and analyzing production data; experienced applying statistical analysis tools to evaluate and improve production processes; able to create clear work instructions and training materials; proficient in Excel; familiar with production equipment and preventative maintenance concepts; experienced building cost-benefit analyses for capital investments and managing capital projects from justification through implementation; able to collaborate across production, quality, engineering, procurement, and leadership. Ideally also experienced with Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, 5S, Kaizen, ISO 9001, or similar methodologies.

Within your first year, you'll help establish labor standards, improve production visibility through meaningful metrics, strengthen work instructions and training documentation, improve equipment reliability, and identify process improvements that increase throughput, quality, and efficiency.

To apply, reach out to careers@qualitycablesystems.com.

positions.title: Cost & Quoting Engineer
positions.summary: Own the quoting process from RFQ to submission, bridging sales, engineering, and production to price wire harness and cable assembly work accurately and competitively.
positions.description:
Quality Cable Systems (QCS) builds wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and box builds for OEM customers who depend on quality, reliability, and responsiveness. We're under new leadership and investing in technology, people, and processes to build the next generation of QCS.

We're currently looking for a Cost & Quoting Engineer to help drive our next phase of growth. This role sits at the center of sales, engineering, and operations, helping us win profitable business by turning customer drawings into accurate, competitive, and executable quotes. If you enjoy solving technical problems, working cross-functionally, and seeing the direct impact of your work on a growing business, we'd love to talk with you.

Our headquarters is in Kansas City, MO, but we're open to remote for the right candidate. Start date is flexible. You will report directly to the CEO and work closely with sales, engineering, and production. This is an individual contributor role with strong cross-functional collaboration.

What you'll do: own the quoting process from customer RFQ through final quote submission, ensuring we price work accurately, competitively, and with a clear understanding of how it will be manufactured. Day to day, you'll review customer drawings, specifications, and bills of material for wire harnesses, cable assemblies, and box builds. You'll develop detailed material takeoffs, labor estimates, and manufacturing assumptions. You'll research component pricing, evaluate sourcing options, and work closely with suppliers to ensure quotes reflect current market conditions. You'll partner with Sales Engineers, Manufacturing Engineers, and production leaders to identify risks, improve manufacturability, and ensure proposals can be executed successfully. Over time, you'll help build a world-class quoting process by improving estimating accuracy, developing labor standards, and analyzing quote-to-actual performance.

We offer competitive compensation based on experience and are happy to discuss details during the interview process.

What we're looking for: experienced in wire harness, cable assembly, control panel, or similar electromechanical manufacturing; comfortable reading and interpreting technical drawings, specifications, and bills of material; experienced building material takeoffs, labor estimates, and cost models; detail-oriented with strong analytical and problem-solving skills; comfortable working with supplier pricing and sourcing considerations; able to collaborate across sales, engineering, procurement, and production; organized and able to manage multiple quotes and priorities simultaneously; proficient in Excel; familiar with ERP, MRP, quoting, or manufacturing systems. Ideally also experienced with IPC/WHMA-A-620 standards and technical estimating within a manufacturing environment.

To apply, reach out to careers@qualitycablesystems.com.
